cleanIntro:
The PWS MK118 MOD 2 is an AR-pattern rifle on PWS's long-stroke gas piston: the piston rod and piston head ride on the bolt carrier group, so carbon stays in the piston tube up front instead of being blown into the action. The gas adjustment knob at the gas block has three settings for shooting (1 unsuppressed, 2 and 3 suppressed) and an X setting used only for maintenance.

PWS's routine maintenance is one disassembly for all its rifles: the upper comes off the lower, the bolt carrier group comes out on the charging handle, the piston head and charging handle come off the piston rod, and the bolt is stripped down to the extractor. The gas system clean is the deeper step, and the handguard stays on.

steps.title: Unload, clear, on SAFE
steps.action: Point the muzzle in a safe direction. Remove the magazine, draw the charging handle back and look into the chamber to see it empty. Put the selector on SAFE.
steps.prose: Seeing the empty chamber is the check; a magazine left seated only feeds the next round.
steps.quote: Unload and clear your firearm, be sure your firearm is on safe.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 1, printed p.6

steps.title: Bolt carrier group forward
steps.action: Let the bolt carrier group go fully forward before you start pushing pins.
steps.prose: PWS starts the disassembly from a closed action.
steps.quote: Ensure the bolt carrier group is forward before proceeding.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 2, printed p.6

steps.title: Rear takedown pin: left to right
steps.action: Push the rear takedown pin from the left side toward the right until it stops.
steps.prose: The pin is held by a detent in the lower receiver; it stops there and does not come out of the gun.
steps.quote: Press the back take-down pin from left to right until it is stopped by the detent in the lower receiver.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 3, printed p.6

steps.title: Front pivot pin: left to right
steps.action: Push the front pivot pin from left to right the same way, until the detent stops it.
steps.prose: Both pins move the same direction and both stay captive in the lower.
steps.quote: Press the front pivot pin from left to right until it is stopped by the detent in the lower receiver.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 4, printed p.6

steps.title: Upper off the lower
steps.action: Lift the upper receiver away from the lower receiver.
steps.prose: With both pins out to their stops the two halves are free of each other.
steps.quote: At this time, the upper receiver and lower receiver will detach from each other.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 5, printed p.6

steps.title: Charging handle back to its stop
steps.action: Pull the charging handle back out of the rear of the upper until it stops. Turning the upper 45 to 90 degrees, charging handle away from you, makes it easier.
steps.prose: The handle only comes back to its stop here; it leaves the upper together with the carrier in a moment.
steps.quote: Pull the charging handle from the back of the upper receiver until it stops. It is easiest to turn the upper 45-90 degrees so the charging handle is facing opposite of you.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 6, printed p.6

steps.title: Carrier back onto the charging handle
steps.action: Draw the bolt carrier group back until it catches on the charging handle.
steps.prose: The piston rod on the carrier is what the charging handle catches.
steps.quote: Pull the bolt carrier group back until it catches on the charging handle.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 7, printed p.6

steps.title: Carrier and charging handle out together
steps.action: Lift the bolt carrier group up, away from the charging handle, then pull the carrier and charging handle out of the upper receiver together.
steps.prose: They come out as one piece; you separate them on the bench.
steps.quote: Lift the bolt carrier group up (away from the charging handle). The bolt carrier group with charging handle will now be free to pull away from the upper receiver.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 8, printed p.6

steps.title: Piston head off
steps.action: Turn the piston head on the front of the piston rod until it slips off.
steps.prose: Turn it until it lines up; it should slip off easily, not be forced.
steps.quote: Turn the piston head until it can easily slip off.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 9, printed p.6

steps.title: Charging handle off over the piston rod
steps.action: Slide the charging handle off forward over the piston rod.
steps.prose: With the piston head off, nothing holds the handle on the rod.
steps.quote: Remove the charging handle over the piston rod.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 10, printed p.6

steps.title: Firing pin retaining pin out
steps.action: Push out the firing pin retaining pin from the side of the carrier and take the firing pin out of the rear.
steps.prose: The retaining pin is all that holds the firing pin in.
steps.quote: Remove firing pin retaining pin, which will release the firing pin.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 11, printed p.6

steps.title: Cam pin turned and out — bolt out
steps.action: Press the bolt back into the carrier, turn the cam pin 90 degrees and lift it out. Keep a hand on the bolt: it is spring assisted and comes out of the carrier as soon as the cam pin is gone.
steps.prose: Pressing the bolt in takes the load off the cam pin so it turns freely.
steps.caution: the bolt assembly is spring assisted and will easily separate at this time.
steps.quote: Depress bolt assembly group into carrier, turn cam pin 90 degrees and remove.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 12, printed p.6

steps.title: Press the extractor
steps.action: Press on the round side of the extractor to take the load off the extractor pin.
steps.prose: The extractor spring keeps the pin bound until you hold the extractor down.
steps.quote: Apply pressure on the round side of the extractor to relieve pressure on extractor pin.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 13, printed p.6

steps.title: Extractor pin out
steps.action: While holding the extractor, push the extractor pin out of the bolt with a punch or the tip of the firing pin, from either side.
steps.prose: The pin has no preferred direction.
steps.quote: Using a punch/tip of firing pin, push the extractor pin from the bolt; direction does not matter.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 14, printed p.6

steps.title: Extractor out
steps.action: Lift the extractor off the bolt.
steps.prose: Keep the extractor, its pin and the bolt together on the bench.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 15, printed p.6

steps.title: Buffer and recoil spring out of the lower
steps.action: In the lower receiver, press down the buffer retainer and take the buffer and recoil spring out of the buffer tube.
steps.prose: The recoil spring pushes the buffer out against the retainer; let it come out under control.
steps.quote: In the lower receiver, depress the buffer retainer and remove the buffer and recoil spring.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Routine Maintenance, step 16, printed p.6

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: On the bench: the upper and lower receivers, the charging handle, the bolt carrier with its piston rod, the piston head, the firing pin and its retaining pin, the cam pin, the bolt, the extractor and its pin, the buffer and the recoil spring. DEEP CLEAN carries PWS's gas system maintenance: the gas adjustment knob out of the gas block.
steps.prose: This is the whole disassembly PWS's lubrication page sends you to before cleaning.
steps.quote: To lubricate your firearm, follow disassembly instructions #1-16 on pg. 6.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Lubrication, printed p.8

deepSteps.title: Gas adjustment knob to X
deepSteps.action: With the narrow end of the rifle service tool in the gas adjustment knob, turn it to the X setting.
deepSteps.prose: X is the maintenance setting only; the knob is removed from it here.
deepSteps.caution: NEVER FIRE YOUR PWS RIFLE WITH THE GAS ADJUSTMENT SETTING ON “X.” ONLY OPERATE THE RIFLE ON SETTINGS 1, 2 OR 3.
deepSteps.quote: Using your rifle service tool, turn the gas adjustment knob to the X-setting.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Gas System Maintenance, All Other Lines, step 1, printed p.9

deepSteps.title: Knock the knob out from the rear
deepSteps.action: From the back of the upper receiver, run a long cleaning rod into the piston tube above the barrel and tap the back of the rod until the knob comes loose toward the muzzle device.
deepSteps.prose: Carbon holds the knob in the gas block; with heavy buildup it can take some effort.
deepSteps.quote: Place a long cleaning rod in the back of the upper receiver into the piston tube located above the barrel and tap the back of the cleaning rod against the gas adjustment knob until the knob knocked loose towards the muzzle device.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Gas System Maintenance, All Other Lines, step 2, printed p.9

deepSteps.title: Handguard stays on — PWS's stopping point
deepSteps.action: Stop here. The handguard stays on; carbon on the barrel under it is rubbed off in place. Anything further is for a PWS Armorer.
deepSteps.prose: PWS says its piston system is proprietary and needs PWS-made tools past this point.
deepSteps.quote: Disassembly further than shown in this manual should ONLY be done by a PWS Armorer.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK1 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — back page prints a revision line that extracts as "REVIS-E1D2-7. 26" (the letters and digits of a REVISED date interleave in the text layer); file name 2026_MK1_Manual_DIGITAL — Gas System / In-Depth Maintenance, printed p.8

cleaning.name: BOLT CARRIER GROUP
tasks: Flush the surfaces of the bolt carrier group parts with solvent.
A Scotch-Brite pad may be used on hardened carbon on the bolt carrier group parts and the piston head.
Reassemble the bolt carrier group and lubricate all of it, every contact point well.
⚠ Piston rod and piston head: wipe them down before reassembly only — PWS says they do not need lubrication.

cleaning.name: PISTON TUBE AND BUFFER TUBE
tasks: A .40 cal cleaning brush through the piston tube to clear carbon and debris.
Flush the buffer tube with solvent and remove the excess.
An even layer of lubricant inside the buffer tube.

cleaning.name: BARREL UNDER THE HANDGUARD
tasks: Carbon on the barrel under the handguard: oil and a brush or a cotton swab to rub it off.
⚠ Leave the handguard on — PWS warns that removing it can cause accuracy issues if it is not re-installed properly.

cleaning.name: GAS SYSTEM
tasks: Deep clean: the piston tube and gas block with a .40 cal cleaning brush.
Deep clean: the gas adjustment knob with a wire brush or a Scotch-Brite pad as needed.

reassembly: Deep clean only: gas adjustment knob back into the gas block on the X setting, pushed in until it is fully seated against the gas block.
Extractor back on the bolt and the extractor pin pushed back through; bolt into the carrier, cam pin in and turned, firing pin in from the rear and its retaining pin back in.
Lubricate the reassembled bolt carrier group at every contact point; the piston rod and piston head are wiped, not oiled.
Buffer and recoil spring back into the buffer tube, past the buffer retainer.
Charging handle back over the piston rod and the piston head turned back on.
Bolt carrier group with the charging handle back into the upper receiver; upper onto the lower, front pivot pin and rear takedown pin pushed home.
⚠ Set the gas adjustment knob to your shooting setting, 1, 2 or 3 — never leave it on X.
Run the function check before loading.
fncheck: PWS's book publishes no function check. Clear the rifle first. Confirm both receiver pins are fully home and the gas adjustment knob sits on setting 1, 2 or 3, not X. Then clear the rifle again.
